publisher: Wisconsin Department of Health Services; Department of Children and Families
ownership: Official DHS GIS distribution of DCF-regulated provider evidence; no claim that all underlying rights belong to DHS.
allowed_use: internal evidence retention and local-review processing
prohibited_use: account or agreement acceptance on the user's behalf
advertising or product endorsement implying publisher or third-party endorsement
querying unselected contacts or non-group categories
inferring operating dates, ownership, identity or address accuracy
acquisition_gate: This development policy is not acquisition approval. Retained terms describe use as acceptance; complete the operator's source-use decision and verified app connector before live collection.
attribution: Wisconsin Department of Health Services; Wisconsin Department of Children and Families
retention: Immutable local evidence; operator-governed deletion, no automatic cleanup.
personal_data_handling: Business names and premises may identify people. Exclude contact fields and other care categories before retrieval; group membership is not proof that an address is nonresidential.
coordinate_handling: Publisher-returned EPSG:4326 point geometry only, with explicit CRS validation. Attribute datum remains unverified; never infer ZIP or attach polygons to businesses.

evidence.limitations: Publisher counts/status and metadata clocks do not establish unique active businesses, source freshness or national completeness. No payment/account or explicit indemnification requirement was found in the retained notice; that is not a legal determination.
